copy.curiosityHook: With a ruthless cattle baron hunting him down and only an erratic expatriate by his side, can one rifleman survive the untamed territory?
copy.description: Hired by an Australian land baron under the guise of shooting dingoes, American rifleman Matt Quigley rebels when the true human quarry is revealed, triggering a lethal cat-and-mouse chase across the rugged Outback.
copy.vibeSummary: Exciting and suspenseful, this Outback chase moves at a steady clip with engaged focus and moderate grit.
copy.whyWatch: Simon Wincer retools the Western frontier into an expansive Australian survival pursuit, powered by sharpshooting tension, moral clarity, and escalating open-country suspense.

allowedMaterial: American rifleman Matt Quigley accepts a contract to cull dingoes
